lines.text: Look at this picture. On the left, a mind made of glowing pieces, standing apart from the person.
On the right, the same pieces, worn like a helmet. Same material. Two different futures.
Nothing is added. Nothing is taken away. Only the arrangement changes.
The pieces are an AI model, plus its instructions, its memory, its files, and its tools.
Built one way, they stand apart from you: powerful, generic, and owned by someone else.
Built the other way, they wrap around you: a second cortex that keeps your memory, your rules, your files.
The model is just raw intelligence. The harness is where your way of working lives.
So don't just use the mind standing apart. Wear the one that's built around you. Own your harness.
